fn Exp_int(x: Int, y: Int) -> Int
  requires (x >= 0)
  requires (y >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (y == 0) then 1 else (x * Exp_int(x, (y - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (Exp_int(0, 0) == 1)
  example (Exp_int(0, 1) == 0)
{
  if (y == 0) then 1 else (x * Exp_int(x, (y - 1)))
}

fn ModExp_int(x: Int, y: Int, n: Int, z: Int) -> Int
  requires (x >= 0)
  requires (y >= 0)
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (z >= 0)
  requires (y < Exp_int(2, (n + 1)))
  requires (z > 1)
  ensures (result == (Exp_int(x, y) % z))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (ModExp_int(0, 0, 0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
